dependency_evidence: SV2-GAT-02 merged into dev as pull request 7486; this package delivers the project pack that path retrieves and never retrieves it itself.
evidence_class: mocked for the fixture cases: hooks run in a temporary agentihooks home with the brain refresh and project retrieval patched to return the fixture packs, through the Claude and Codex target emitters; live: one Claude and one Codex session on a hive worker ran the branch hooks with an isolated agentihooks home
interfaces: hooks.context.task_context.offer(session_id, event, pack, injectable) returns the pack only when the current target can inject at that event, writes a delivery receipt (pack sha256, event, target, time) under the project cache namespace and counts delivered; it returns nothing and counts deduplicated when the receipt already carries the same digest
An event the target cannot inject at (Codex PreToolUse) holds the pack for the next injectable event and counts unsupported_event; retrieval at that event never writes a receipt
hooks.context.task_context.deliver_pending(session_id, event) offers the held pack; hook_manager.on_post_tool_use calls it, so Codex receives the pack at PostToolUse

hooks.context.task_context.restart(session_id) drops the receipt and any held pack; brain_adapter.inject_on_session_start calls it before offering, so a startup, resume or compaction SessionStart delivers the current pack once and a stale held pack is never replayed
A newer held pack replaces an older one for the same session
AGENTIHOOKS_TASK_CONTEXT_OFF=<comma separated targets> disables delivery for those targets and counts disabled; the fleet brain feed broadcast is unchanged
hooks.context.brain_adapter.get_status, the brain_status tool, reports context_delivery_outcomes_by_target
The pack keeps its BRAIN CONTEXT (recalled state, not an operator directive) framing from the project memory renderer

supported_versions.targets: claude and codex, through hooks.targets.capabilities.can_inject_context: Claude injects at SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse and PostToolUse; Codex injects at SessionStart and PostToolUse and not at PreToolUse
supported_versions.cli_versions: The live smoke ran the Claude Code and Codex CLIs installed in the hive worker image; the smoke did not record their version strings

states.observed: The fixture cases A, B and C ran in the touched tests job https://github.com/the-cloud-clockwork/agentihooks/actions/runs/40382454881/job/121781988190 at 71af5fff70b7; the Proofs mutation run https://github.com/the-cloud-clockwork/agentihooks/actions/runs/40385218043 passed at b88480c58ed148b0f6f408688f38330cec3acd98, which adds only these records. Live: Claude session 8415c8ec and Codex session 01a17930 each received the pack at SessionStart with a receipt; the pack text appears in the Claude transcript and in the Codex rollout; a second run that refreshed on every tool call recorded deduplicated 1 on Claude.
states.accepted: A delivery is accepted when offer returns the pack for an event the target can inject at; the receipt is written in the same call.
states.committed: The receipt file and the context_delivery_outcomes_by_target counter file under the agentihooks home brain state folder, and the held pack file of the project cache, are the only writes.
states.externally_verified: The pack text was read back from the Claude transcript and the Codex rollout of the live smoke sessions; no deployed swarm session has been checked yet, which belongs to the G6 rollout gate.

metrics.context_delivery_outcomes_by_target: per target counts in $AGENTIHOOKS_HOME brain state folder context_delivery_outcomes_by_target.json: delivered, deduplicated, unsupported_event and disabled

rollback_rehearsal.action: Set AGENTIHOOKS_TASK_CONTEXT_OFF to the affected target (claude, codex or both); that target gets no project pack while the fleet brain feed keeps reaching it.
rollback_rehearsal.authoritative_objects: The brain's project feed and the project memory cache are retrieval state and are untouched by rollback; the receipt and the outcome counter are derived and may be discarded.
rollback_rehearsal.proof: test_b_a_disabled_target_gets_no_pack_and_keeps_its_fleet_feed returns the fleet feed with no pack and no receipt for a disabled Codex target, counts disabled, and delivers again once the target leaves the list.

remaining_limitations: The receipt records that the pack entered a supported hook envelope; it does not read the model's context back. The live transcript and rollout check is manual.
Claude's injection budget can truncate a long pack after the receipt is written.
The live smoke unset the swarm brain binding variable, because on hive workers it forces the brain off; a swarm worker with that binding gets no pack until the binding admits the brain.
Copilot runs the same capability path but has no fixture case or live smoke in this package.
compatibility: Compared with the preceding accepted path, where the project pack was injected at every SessionStart and Claude PreToolUse refresh and deferred to Codex PostToolUse with no receipt: the same events still carry it, now once per changed pack.
authority: The pack comes only from the session's resolved project memory; delivery adds no grant and the brain-api keeps enforcing the token's project scope.
